items.title: How Anthropic Went From Anti-Product to $81B a Year
items.summary: A Thanksgiving extra from my new show, How We Got Here. In 2021, Anthropic was a safety lab meeting in a park, and its founders had ruled out selling anything. Five years later it was bringing in $81 billion a year. This excerpt from this week's episode covers how that happened: the chatbot they wouldn't release, the investor who turned out to be a fraud, and the bet on coding that changed the business of AI.
